entries.summary: Design/settings store position (relative|sticky), z_index (1–100), and sticky_offset keys. compileStylesheet emits position/top/z-index from hardcoded maps. fixed/absolute and out-of-range z-index are dropped. Hover bags strip position keys.
Advanced inspector adds Position, Z-index, and Sticky offset. Changes patch live CSS. Copy style omits these keys (appearance only). Never written into design_hover.
No schema change. Keys live in layout_json design/settings bags and restore with the SQL dump. Public CSS stays derived at render time.
